status: registered before execution; measurement only (T5 region-fixed dense stream, v0)
question: In one dense region (hiroshima), how many days after the landslide does the frozen readout first detect it when the state is built from the observation prefix available at that time?
data: olmo_streaming_dev/teacher_fp16 hiroshima tiles: pooled states for prefixes [0:c], c in {4,6,8,10,12} (same encoder contract; synthetic-month timestamps per MS-116 extraction); real dates from contract; post_index for the event boundary; sealed readout resolution_contract_v2/p4_native_control/holdout_hiroshima_seed1

curve: detection rate and mean IoU vs number of post-event observations in the prefix and vs days_since_event bins [<0, 0-30, 31-60, 61-120, >120]
days-to-first-detection distribution over tiles (first cutoff with detected=true)
